hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && if [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ]; then git pull --ff-only -q origin main >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Session start: main pulled, now at $(git log --oneline -1)" || echo "Session start: git pull of main failed (offline, local changes or diverged); pull by hand before editing."; fi; true
